title: arenaria serpyllifolia var. viscida
intro: Arenaria serpyllifolia var. viscida, commonly known as sticky pearlwort, is a variety of flowering plant in the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of sticky pearlwort are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may help to soothe and calm the body. However, further research is needed to fully understand the effectiveness and safety of sticky pearlwort for medicinal use.
